result.explanation: Implements pinned FIFO residents with in-place live replacement, FIFO admission eviction, tombstone retention, pin accounting, invalidation, and exact per-event output projection.
result.program: function solve(x){let s=x.state||[],e=x.event,c=x.config.capacity,k=e.key,t=e.type,i=-1;for(let j=0;j<s.length;j++)if(s[j][0]===k){i=j;break}let z="ignored",v=null;if(t==="put"){if(i>=0){if(s[i][3])z="blocked";else{s[i][1]=e.value;z="stored"}}else if(s.length<c){s.push([k,e.value,0,0]);z="stored"}else{let q=-1;for(let j=0;j<s.length;j++)if(s[j][2]===0){q=j;break}if(q<0)z="blocked";else{s.splice(q,1);s.push([k,e.value,0,0]);z="stored"}}}else if(t==="pin"){if(i>=0&&!s[i][3]){s[i][2]++;z="pinned"}}else if(t==="unpin"){if(i>=0&&s[i][2]>0){s[i][2]--;z="released";if(s[i][3]&&!s[i][2])s.splice(i,1)}}else if(t==="invalidate"){if(i<0)z="missing";else if(!s[i][2]){s.splice(i,1);z="invalidated"}else if(!s[i][3]){s[i][3]=1;z="invalidated"}}else if(t==="get"){if(i>=0&&!s[i][3]){v=s[i][1];z="hit"}else z="miss"}let o=[],p={},r=[];for(let a of s){o.push(a[0]);p[a[0]]=a[2];if(a[3])r.push(a[0])}r.sort();return{state:s,output:{order:o,pins:p,status:z,tombstones:r,value:v}}}
